" :question/worked-solution "The full matrix product is $$ D=\begin{bmatrix}{\color{lightgray}{-1}} & {\color{lightgray}{2}} & {\color{lightgray}{4}} \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ {\color{lightgray}{-1}} & {\color{lightgray}{1}} & {\color{lightgray}{0}} \\ {\color{lightgray}{0}} & {\color{lightgray}{4}} & {\color{lightgray}{-7}}\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}{\color{lightgray}{1}} & {\color{lightgray}{1}} & {\color{lightgray}{-2}} & -3 \\ {\color{lightgray}{0}} & {\color{lightgray}{4}} & {\color{lightgray}{-1}} & 1 \\ {\color{lightgray}{2}} & {\color{lightgray}{0}} & {\color{lightgray}{3}} & -3\end{bmatrix} $$ Multiplying the $2$nd row in $A$ by the $4$th column in $B$, we get $$ \begin{aligned}{d}_{24} & =\begin{bmatrix}3 & 4 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} \\ & =3\cdot (-3)+4\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot (-3) \\ & =-9+4+3 \\ & =-2.\end{aligned} $$"} {:db/id 17592186292866 :question/answer-fields [{:answer-field/choices [{:answer/id #uuid "73870312-24b0-5710-9582-ace4d833975f" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "14" :db/id 17592186291128}] :answer-field/correct {:answer/id #uuid "73870312-24b0-5710-9582-ace4d833975f" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "14" :db/id 17592186291128} :answer-field/id #uuid "61916db7-9570-5896-8478-8a654eab7267" :answer-field/key "field-1" :answer-field/type {:db/ident :answer-field.type/blank} :db/id 17592186292032}] :question/difficulty {:db/ident :question.difficulty/easy} :question/id #uuid "375c7db7-262a-5420-9a53-a13dd2a5b997" :question/math-academy-id "q-275547" :question/problem "Let $L=MN.$ What is the value of ${l}_{22}$, if
